clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for  self finished glass fibre bitumen felts used for waterproofing and damp proofing. Note — Glass fibre base bitumen felts are suitable for waterproofing and damp-proofing in buildings and other situations where penetration of moisture is to be stopped.

clauses.title: Classification
clauses.text: 2. Classification a) Grade 1 — Talcum, mica or sand surface glass fibre base bitumen felts for water-proofing b) Grade 2 — Talcum, mica or sand surfaced glass fibre base bitumen felts for damp-proofing.

clauses.title: Dimensions
clauses.text: 3. Dimensions — Bitumen felts in width of one metre and generally in lengths of 1,10 and 20m.
